# Highlight.js

Vendored browser build of Highlight.js **11.12.0**, including the common language
bundle and the CMake grammar. The site loads these files locally; no CDN request
is required to highlight article code.

- Build: https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release/tree/11.12.0/build
- Upstream: https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/tree/11.12.0
- License: BSD 3-Clause; see `LICENSE`.

PTX and SASS token rules and conservative language detection live in
`assets/post-content.js`. Theme colors live in `assets/site.css`.
